title: GO:0000018: t-SNE of Conjoint triad
caption: t-SNE projection of all 1500 proteins in the GO:0000018 pool, described by Conjoint triad (343 dimensions). Silhouette of the two classes in the 2-D map: 0.11. Axes have no units, and distances between far-apart clusters are not meaningful. Positives are drawn on top of negatives.
